label: News Take
line: The event with its actor and its irony in the first sentence, why it matters to the viewer, the biggest claim, the evidence for it, the catch, and a take.
best_for: something that happened in the last few weeks, with one actor and one surprising act
a release or an announcement whose main claim can be checked
also_for: a finding or a leak that changes what the viewer thought about something they own
avoid_for: a story the audience has already seen covered
an event with no claim that can be checked
a rumour: the event and the catch each need a source
signals: it happened within the last few weeks
one named actor did one surprising thing
there is a claim that can be checked

beats.name: What happened
beats.job: The event with its date, its actor and the irony or the opponent. A date, never 'last week': the video may be posted later.

beats.name: Why it matters to you
beats.job: What it changes for the viewer.

beats.name: On the surface, yes
beats.job: The evidence that the claim holds.

beats.name: The catch
beats.job: One detail from a source that limits it.

beats.name: The take
beats.job: Who gains, who loses, or the honest limits.

hooks.shape: On [date], [actor] got so tired of [practice] that [surprising act].
[Actor] just showed that your [thing you own] [surprising fact].
[Actor] spent [years] building [X]. On [date] it [did the opposite].

holds: The event is in the first sentence, so nothing is spent on backstory. The viewer stays to learn whether the claim is true, and the catch re-opens it once the evidence seems to settle it.
ending: The take, or the honest limits of the news. No forecast stated as fact.
pitfalls: Leaving the event after promising it
A claim or a catch with no source
News the audience has already seen: it dates within days
template: On [date], [actor] [did surprising thing], with [one irony]. This matters to you because [what it changes]. In plain terms, [the biggest claim]. Is it true? On the surface, yes: [evidence]. But [the catch, from a source]. [The take].
